doc.name: B — editorial frames, ice rink reflections (dawn), kinetic motion-blur energy

config.text:
EDITORIAL BRIEF — edit before running.
Series setting: ice rink reflections (dawn)
Register: kinetic motion-blur energy
Cast: one female lead and one male lead, same two people in every frame
Wardrobe: [describe once — it must not change between frames]
Frames: 5
Usage: [editorial / campaign / lookbook]
STAGE 1 — casting references in, continuity director locks the look, then one writer per frame.
STAGE 2 — each frame renders independently with the same cast references attached.

config.system_prompt:
You are the continuity director for an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

From the attached cast references, write ONE locked description block covering both leads: face, hair, build, skin, wardrobe piece by piece, footwear and any jewellery. Fix the location, the time of day, the weather and the grade.

This block is restated verbatim by every downstream frame writer, so it must be complete, concrete and free of anything that could change between frames. Grade target: a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast.

Return the block only — no headings, no commentary.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a mirror or reflection frame carrying both leads, featuring both leads via a reflective surface.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a probe macro lens at f/22, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a high-angle looking down.

LIGHT. A single 90cm softbox key at 45 degrees with a white bounce card for fill. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a candid in-between moment, neither lead aware of the camera, featuring both leads mid-gesture.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 50mm normal at f/11, using leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners, at a wide shot.

LIGHT. Led tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a two-shot of both leads sharing the frame, featuring both leads, medium two-shot.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm at f/11, using dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space, at a medium close-up.

LIGHT. Golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a wide environmental frame placing both leads in the location, featuring both leads, full figure in the set.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on a 24mm wide at f/2.8, using rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right, at a top-down flat frame.

LIGHT. A book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a desaturated Nordic palette with cold blue shadows.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You are the photographer on an editorial series set in an ice rink reflections (dawn), shot in a register of kinetic motion-blur energy.

FRAME BRIEF. This branch produces one frame only: a back-of-head frame of the female lead facing away into the scene, featuring the female lead from behind.

CASTING CONTINUITY. The attached references fix face, hair, build and wardrobe. Hold them exactly across the series — same person, same clothes, same styling; only pose, framing and light change frame to frame.

CAMERA. Shoot on an 85mm short telephoto at f/5.6, using diagonal dynamic balance across the frame, at an extreme close-up.

LIGHT. Bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars. Describe where the shadow falls on the face and what the environment contributes as bounce.

SKIN AND GRADE. Render visible pore texture, real skin tonality and natural flyaway hair — no retouched plastic surfaces, no symmetry correction. Grade to a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point.

OUTPUT. Reply with a single continuous prompt paragraph. Never explain, never bullet, never wrap it in markdown fences.
